description: Sentiment & Emotion Flow River by Office Solution The Sentiment & Emotion Flow River is an advanced Power BI custom visual designed to map customer sentiment dynamics, emotional transitions, and feedback distribution over time or customer journey stages. Combining alluvial flow architecture with organic river stream layers, it delivers an intuitive view of how sentiment intensity, emotional drivers, and volume evolve across channels and product touchpoints. Key Concepts: Temporal & Stage Rivers: Flowing organic streams connecting stages (Awareness, Onboarding, Renewal) or chronological time periods. Sentiment & Emotion Bands: Distinct color-coded stream bands reflecting emotional states (Joy, Trust, Frustration, Anger, Neutral) or Net Sentiment. Multi-Dimensional Thickness: Stream thickness and height dynamically scale by feedback volume, review count, or user interaction volume. Key Features: Interactive Flow Scrubbing: Smoothly trace sentiment evolution across stages with highlighted connector bands. Multi-Dimensional Breakdown: Slice emotions across channels, product categories, or survey response topics. Hover Inspection & Text Drilldown: Rich contextual tooltips showing emotion intensity scores, sample review excerpts, and volume metrics.
